cell.offNoTracking.note: the domains table's Tracking cell of a Transactional domain: links and opens aren't tracked

cell.notChecked.note: a cell of the domains table (SPF, DMARC, BIMI) before the first DNS check

cell.notSetUp.note: the DKIM cell: no provider has records for the domain

cell.providers.message: {verified, number} of {total, plural, one {# provider} other {# providers}}
cell.providers.note: the DKIM cell: how many of the domain's providers have verified DKIM

cell.pendingRecord.note: the DKIM cell: the first record still pending; type is a DNS record type (CNAME, TXT)

cell.tooManyLookups.note: the SPF cell: the record needs more than 10 DNS lookups

cell.default.note: the Return path cell: the providers use their own return-path domain

cell.none.note: the Tracking cell: no custom tracking domain

cell.trackingNotPointed.note: the Tracking cell: the tracking domain's CNAME doesn't point to ReputeCast yet

cell.set.note: the BIMI cell: a BIMI record is published

status.verified.note: a DNS record's status on the domain's records page

status.cachedTTL.note: a TXT record was changed but resolvers still serve the old value; ttl: seconds

record.dkimOf.note: a record's purpose: the provider's nth DKIM record

record.returnPathNote: so bounces and SPF align with your domain
record.dmarcNote: required by Gmail and Yahoo for bulk senders

record.easyDKIM.note: Amazon SES's DKIM records; Easy DKIM is SES's name for them

verification.verified.note: a sender's badge in a provider's column

verification.pending.note: the provider waits for the domain's DKIM records

verification.notUsed.note: the sender never sends through this provider

note.noRecords.message: {provider} has no records for {domain} yet. Fetch them to send as this domain through {short}.
note.noRecords.note: provider: a sending provider's name; short: its short name (SES)

note.addInDashboard: Add {domain} in {provider} and publish the DKIM record it shows there. ReputeCast checks SPF and DMARC here and the rest on the first send.

tip.inherited.message: {domain} follows `p={policy}` from {org}'s DMARC record.{reports, select, yes { Reports go to HostRepute and appear in Deliverability.} other {}}
tip.inherited.note: after "DMARC tip:"; `backticks` mark code; policy: none, quarantine or reject, never translated; org: the organizational domain

tip.publishes: {domain} publishes `p={policy}`.{reports, select, yes { Reports go to HostRepute and appear in Deliverability.} other {}}

tip.suggest.message: start with `p=none` if other services also send as {domain}; ReputeCast suggested `p={suggested}` because only {count, plural, =0 {no provider is} one {{providers} is} other {{providers} are}} configured.{reports, select, yes { Reports go to HostRepute and appear in Deliverability.} other {}}
tip.suggest.note: after "DMARC tip:", so it starts with a small letter; providers: the configured providers' short names, already joined (SES and Postal)

problem.notSendingDomain: {domain} isn't a sending domain of this workspace yet. Add the domain first, then the sender.
problem.notTransactionalDefault: {email} isn't on a Transactional domain, so it can't be the default From of transactional templates.
problem.addressFixed: A sender's address can't change. Add a new sender instead.
problem.pickSender: Pick a sender of this workspace.
problem.trackingFirst: Add {domain} as the tracking domain of a sending domain first.

problem.notTransactional.message: {email} isn't on a Transactional domain. Pick a sender on one, such as a notify. subdomain kept for product mail.
problem.notTransactional.note: notify. is a subdomain's first label, never translated

problem.alreadyDomain: {domain} is already a sending domain of this workspace.
problem.subdomain: Use a subdomain of {domain}, for example go.{domain}.
problem.sendersUse: {count, plural, one {# sender uses} other {# senders use}} {domain}. Delete them first, so no campaign loses its From address.

problem.providerAdd.note: error: the provider's own answer, in English

problem.cloudflareToken: Cloudflare rejected this token. Use an API token with Zone › DNS › Edit permission on {domain}'s zone.

problem.cloudflareUnreachable.message: couldn't reach Cloudflare: {error}. Nothing else was changed.
problem.cloudflareUnreachable.note: error: the network error, in English

problem.cloudflareAnswered.message: Cloudflare answered {status}{hasMessage, select, yes {: {message}} other {}}. Nothing else was changed.
problem.cloudflareAnswered.note: status: an HTTP status; message: Cloudflare's own words, in English

problem.cloudflareNoZone: no Cloudflare zone for {domain} is visible to this token. Nothing else was changed.

problem.cloudflareFailed.note: error: what went wrong talking to Cloudflare, in English
